podcast.body: This "lush Technopop-Bop" track from the British duo Wang Chung was a top 20 hit in the summer of 1984. Its sound was noted as being similar to Ray Parker, Jr.'s "I just can't get over loving you," indicating a shared musical sensibility across genres and nationalities. "Here's a top 20 hit from British duo Wang Cheng. Their lush Technopop-Bop Dance Hall Days."
